reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes Nb is a low stacking fault energy element for refractory BCC alloys; in BCC metals, deformation twinning is not controlled by SFE in the same way as in FCC, and Nb is a common constituent that typically does not promote nano-twinning in this alloy system.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, using a split-Hopkinson bar and TEM, but it tests a mechanism (SFE-driven nano-twinning) that is physically unsound for this BCC alloy, so the test would not properly evaluate the intended hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental misunderstanding of deformation mechanisms in BCC refractory high-entropy alloys, leading researchers down an unproductive path.
